name: Inotia 3 Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: An unofficial, native Android-to-PS Vita wrapper port of Inotia 3: Children of Carnia (originally developed by Com2uS). This port utilizes so-loader technology, FalsoJNI, and vitaGL to load the official ARMv6 shared library (libgame.so) directly in native PS Vita RAM.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
